title: Specialty Notes Scout
tagline: Ask in plain English about 4,999 public sample medical reports across 40 specialties: find notes on a topic, open one, or see which specialties have few examples. Every count and search result is computed by tools on the data, not guessed by the model.

datasets.name: harishnair04/mtsamples
limitations: Automated inspection: Snapshot inspected 2026-11-16; the source may change after this date.
Automated inspection: Profiled the first 64 rows of config 'default', split 'train' served by the Hugging Face datasets-server, not the full dataset.
Transcription samples from the MTSamples collection as redistributed by a Hugging Face user; the uploader's card states apache-2.0, the original collection's terms were not fetched (unverified).
English-language, US-style dictated reports; not European clinical text.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Keyword search (TF-IDF) over note titles, descriptions, transcriptions and keywords, optionally within one medical specialty. Returns note ids, titles, specialties and descriptions, not the full text.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Return the full transcription of one note, selected by its id (the 'Unnamed: 0' value returned by search_notes).

tools.name: specialty_coverage
tools.description: Count notes per medical specialty, to show which specialties are well covered and which have few examples.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List note ids, titles and descriptions for one medical specialty.

example_questions: Which specialties have the most notes, and which have fewer than 10?
Find notes that mention metformin. Which specialties do they come from?
Find a Neurology note about migraine, open it and summarise how it is structured.
Show me Orthopedic notes about knee pain and open the best match.
